messages.subject: v1.3.0 released
parts:
Hello,

I've released 1.3.0. This speeds up imputation from BAM files, and significantly speeds up analysis from CRAM files, by using SeqLib instead of Rsamtools to access the raw reads. The release is available on github
https://github.com/rwdavies/STITCH

Best,
Robbie
